title: CAD Regression Test Infrastructure — Index, Orchestrator, Dashboard, Triage

status_history.note: 14/15 units shipped (engines + schemas + dispatcher + safety hooks + tests + UI). U-CINF15 runbook delivered. Remaining: WorkerThreadRunner (separate unit U-CINF04.x — orchestrator currently requires injected runner). Wiring gap closed: dispatcher registered in src/index.ts, CAD_REGRESSION_SAFETY_HOOKS spread into allHooks + hooksByCategory.

goal: Build the infrastructure required to orchestrate the 20,006-file regression test: master CAD file index, per-file atomic state tracking, parallel worker orchestration, resumable checkpointing, real-time dashboard, and failure triage.
ultimate_test_contribution: Without this milestone, the 'draw every CAD file' test CANNOT run. This provides the test harness, state persistence, and visibility layer.

exit_criteria.file_index_complete: All 20,006 files cataloged with metadata (format, size, customer, machine_category, complexity)
exit_criteria.orchestrator_benchmarked: Demonstrates 100-file batch in <2min with worker pool
exit_criteria.resumable_verified: Killing orchestrator mid-run and restarting resumes within 1 file of stop point
exit_criteria.dashboard_live: Real-time progress view shows pass/fail/error/pct-complete for 20K files
exit_criteria.failure_triage_taxonomized: Every failure classified into: format_error | parse_error | generation_error | comparison_error | timeout | crash

units.title: CADFileIndexerEngine — master 20,006-file catalog
deliverables: Per-file metadata: {fileId (hash), absolutePath, format, sizeBytes, customer, machineCategory, complexityHint, lastModified}
units.exit: Indexer discovers all 20,006 files; idempotent re-run detects additions/deletions

units.title: CADFileClassifierEngine — part/assembly/drawing/CAM classification
units.exit: Every indexed file has classification tag

units.title: CADTestStateSchema — per-file atomic state
deliverables: TestFileEntrySchema: {fileId, status, errorType, durationMs, retries, artifacts, startedAt, completedAt}
units.exit: Zod schemas compile; sample state JSON validates

units.title: CADRegressionTestOrchestratorEngine — parallel worker pool
deliverables: Uses Node worker_threads (8 workers default, configurable)
Distributes 20K files across workers with load balancing
units.exit: 100-file smoke batch completes in <2min; state persists across restarts

units.title: CADTestCheckpointEngine — resumable state every 100 files
deliverables: Checkpoint save cadence: every 100 completed files OR every 60s
Resume finds last checkpoint + replays only unfinished files
units.exit: Kill -9 mid-run; restart resumes within 1 file of last checkpoint

units.title: CADFailureTriageEngine — classify every failure
deliverables: Captures stack traces and input file context
Groups similar failures by root cause pattern
units.exit: Seeded failure corpus classified with >95% accuracy

units.title: CADArtifactStorageEngine — diff/image/log capture
deliverables: Persist per-file artifacts: expected_step, actual_step, diff_png, error_log
units.exit: Failed test produces inspectable artifact bundle

units.title: CADRegressionDashboardEngine — real-time progress API
units.exit: Web dashboard shows live progress during test run

units.title: CADRegressionDashboardUI — web visualization
deliverables: Progress bar, error-type pie chart, recent failures table
Per-file drill-down view with artifact viewer
units.exit: Operator can watch 20K test run in browser

units.title: CADRegressionResultsAnalyzerEngine — aggregate metrics
deliverables: Pass-rate by customer (ALCOA, ITW, Holo-Krome, SFS, …)
Pass-rate by machine category (lathe vs mill vs EDM)
units.exit: Produces roll-up report: 'Lathe parts: 94.2% pass, Wire EDM: 87.1%, ...'

units.title: CADRegressionReportGeneratorEngine — PDF/HTML reports
deliverables: HTML report with embedded diff images
Executive summary, pass/fail breakdown, top 100 failures

units.title: CADRegressionDispatcher — MCP action routing
deliverables: Actions: start_batch, get_progress, get_results, triage, report

units.title: CADRegressionSafetyHooks — abort on cascading failure
deliverables: Abort batch if >50% crash rate in first 500 files
Alert hook to notify operator on extended runs
units.exit: Seeded 'broken generator' aborts batch before burning 20K runs

units.title: Regression test: 100-file smoke corpus validation
deliverables: Assert: state persists, workers parallel, dashboard updates, artifacts captured

units.title: Documentation + runbook
deliverables: How to kick off 20K run, monitor, abort, interpret results
Troubleshooting: stuck files, memory pressure, disk full
